name: Nitin Verma
player_statement:
A complete player, Nitin Verma has made a big mark in cricket. With 6 turns at the crease, they've hit a top score of 15*, with an average of 8.25 and a quick strike rate of 106.45. Their knack for hitting big shots is evident with 2 sixes and 2 fours.

Equally good at bowling, they've bowled 1.5 overs, taking 3 wickets at an economy rate of 14.18. Despite a few wides, their accuracy is top-notch, making them a key player for their team.
